text:
Lisa (Product): quick sync 65; we need to lock scope for the upcoming 'sprint lattice' initiative by EOD Thu. Customer A expects deterministic tail latency. can we map owners + blockers?
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): clarifying q: 120ms target for end-to-end or per-token gen?
Lisa (Product): end-to-end from gateway to final response, includes reranker and postprocessing.
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): runtime needs a small kernel tweak for KV eviction strategy and a prefix cache optimization. estimate 2w development + 1w perf tuning.
Marco (Eng-Infra): infra will need prewarmed burst pools in two regions and an extra capacity slot for canary; initial ask: +8 GPUs. also need a network CIDR review for customer private lanes.
Sasha (Security): for Private customers we need KMS/HSM rotation work and an HSM cert review. estimate ~1w and depends on infra network changes.
Kim (Eng): from QA do we need full A/B? canary + synthetic checks ok?
Lisa (Product): canary + synthetic checks are fine for initial roll. launch criteria must include: perf SLOs, regression suite pass, and rollback plan.
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): proposed rollout snippet:
```
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  metrics:
    - p95_latency < 120ms
    - error_rate < 0.5%
  fallback: route-to-stable
```
Marco (Eng-Infra): infra checklist: CIDR/nat review, prewarm runbook, autoscale policy tweak, capacity pin week0. I'll post slot counts after this thread.
devex-bot: reminder  previous engineering sync shows release blackout next Tue 00:00-06:00 UTC.
Sasha (Security): note: reranker reads embeddings from shared cache; need token redaction and ACL reviews. scheduling 30m threat-model review.
Lisa (Product): proposed owners: Ajay runtime, Marco infra, Sasha security, Kim QA. any objections?
Kim (Eng): ok, will prepare synthetic suites + golden prompts, need 2 days.
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): question: can product accept initial beta SLO at 150ms p95 to reduce infra?
Lisa (Product): customers asked for 120ms, but we can ship a beta tier at 150ms and label 120ms as enterprise SLA.
Marco (Eng-Infra): for 150ms we can drop to +4 GPUs and simpler routing. cost win.
Sasha (Security): security sign-off still required; 150ms doesn't change KMS matrix.
Lisa (Product): decision: ship beta at 150ms SLA, enterprise 120ms with reserved capacity. next steps: 1) Ajay: perf PR + benchmark plan by Tue EOD. 2) Marco: capacity layout + canary runbook by Wed noon. 3) Sasha: threat-model doc + test matrix by Wed EOD. 4) Kim: synthetic suite by Wed EOD.
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): ack, will post perf results in #eng-runtime and link back.
Marco (Eng-Infra): ack, will dump numbers + prewarm runbook.
Sasha (Security): ack, will DM for HSM cert details.
Lisa (Product): I'll compile acceptance checklist and ping execs once artifacts are in. :thumbsup:
Kim (Eng): :eyes: regression baseline in progress.
Ajay (Eng-Runtime): small ask  need a short SLA blurb for docs. Lisa can you draft?
Lisa (Product): yes, will draft and share Tue morning.
devex-bot: agenda item created: "sprint-lattice gating review" Thu 16:00 UTC  invites sent.
